header:
Problem 9 Reactions of Sulfur Ylides
Sulfur ylides are important intermediates in organic synthesis with distinctive reactivity. Through the Corey–Chaykovsky reaction, they enable transformations such as cyclopropanation, epoxidation, and aziridination. Recent advances in organocatalytic sulfur-ylide reactions have opened new routes to the enantioselective synthesis of complex molecules.
